dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Lawaia told me your fish are the freshest in town.

dialogues.speaker: Teuciztli
dialogues.text: Haha, that kid knows his stuff. Guess I made the right choice hiring him.

dialogues.speaker: Teuciztli
dialogues.text: And judging by how you chose to eat with us, it seems like you know your stuff as well. Here you go, these are for you.

dialogues.speaker: Lawaia
dialogues.text: It's not bad at all. What's strange, though, is today's catch was suddenly much fresher.

dialogues.speaker: Lawaia
dialogues.text: The boss even came to tell me that I'd been working hard lately, and he gave me some Mora as thanks. Talk about a turnaround...

dialogues.speaker: Lawaia
dialogues.text: I'm starting to suspect something... Did he hear about the things I said?

dialogues.speaker: Lawaia
dialogues.text: Bah, whatever. It's not every day that free Mora just falls into your lap. Here, have some — consider it a token of good fortune.
